sentence: Electronics enclosure 100 x 60 x 30 with lid, four M3 insert bosses, rounded edges, cable port
design_notes: Body: rounded-rectangle prism (R6), 2 mm walls and floor, four 7 mm bosses with 4.0 x 6 heat-set insert holes, 8 mm cable port in the +x wall. Lid: 2 mm plate with a 1.6 mm locating lip (0.2 clearance to the wall) and four 3.4 holes; placed at z = 30.
